Title: Fall 2026 Midterm Examination Schedule Published
Body: The midterm examination schedule for all undergraduate programs has been finalized. Please check the university portal for room allocations and timing.

Title: Campus High-Speed Wi-Fi Upgrade Notice
Body: Network infrastructure maintenance will occur this Saturday between 11:00 PM and 03:00 AM. Wi-Fi access may be intermittently unavailable in Academic Building 2.

Title: Registration Open for National Hackathon 2026
Body: All CSE and EEE students are encouraged to register teams for the flagship National Hackathon. Exciting prize pool and industry mentorship opportunities await!

Title: Central Library Extended Hours During Exam Season
Body: Starting next week, the central library and digital reading rooms will remain open until midnight from Sunday through Thursday.
